params.name: cveId
params.description: Returns the change history for a single CVE.

params.name: changeStartDate
params.description: Filter changes that occurred on or after this date (ISO 8601).

params.name: changeEndDate
params.description: Filter changes that occurred on or before this date (ISO 8601).

params.name: resultsPerPage
params.description: Number of change records to return per page (max 5000).

params.name: startIndex
params.description: Zero-based offset into the result set.

items.docs: Returns the change history of CVE records, including modifications to descriptions, references, configurations, and CVSS metrics.
